name: whatsapp-skills
description: 8 skills that turn the context in your head into a ready-to-send WhatsApp message: 1:1 messages, replies, group and community announcements, invitations, promotions, status updates, channel posts, and a formatter that converts Markdown or email text into WhatsApp formatting. Draft-only: nothing is sent for you.

interface.shortDescription: Give the context once, get the WhatsApp message to paste.
interface.longDescription: 8 skills for writing WhatsApp messages: 1:1 messages, replies, group and community announcements, invitations, promotions, status updates, channel posts, and a Markdown-to-WhatsApp formatter. You describe the situation in your own words; the skill returns the final message with correct WhatsApp formatting, exact dates and links, and the tone you asked for.
defaultPrompt: Write a WhatsApp message to my manager that I'm on leave tomorrow.
Announce a meeting change in my team's WhatsApp group.
Make a WhatsApp invite for my sister's wedding.
